clinical_ready_system.mechanics: Path: subscription intake -> guided launch setup -> curriculum + platform live -> students advance through performance gates -> documented remediation -> externship readiness
strict_rules: Students advance by demonstrated readiness — performance gates and skill validation
Document remediation; do not pass students on grade averages alone
Compliance notes always available: 'State requirements vary' and 'Practice verification required'
The school keeps tuition revenue with NO SMV royalties and NO per-student SMV fees
Never use passive income, free money, or side hustle language
Positioning is a practice-based dental assisting school, not a 'side hustle school'
